interactions.note: The epitope-specific CB2 mAb competed with BAFF for binding to hBR3 expressed on BJAB cells (IC50 = 6 nM for IgG protein), essentially neutralizing receptor function. CB2 mAb reduced proliferation of primary human B cells induced by treatment with anti-IgM and BAFF.

interactions.note: The epitope-specific CB2 mAb competed with BAFF for binding to mBR3 expressed on BHK cells (IC50 = 65 nM for IgG protein), essentially neutralizing receptor function. In vivo treatment with CB2 mAb reduced blood and spleen B cell numbers in BALB/C mice, indicating CB2 reduced B cell proliferation.
